answer_1.quote: Driven by these considerations, in this work, we propose e-THERAPIST, a novel gender, age, persona and sentiment-aware polite and interpersonal dialogue system for psychotherapy.

answer_2.quote: In automatic evaluation, e-THERAPIST is evaluated w.r.t (i). attribute-success -Gender-Age consistency (GAc), Persona consistency (Pc), Psychotherapeutic approach correctness (CTc), Politeness correctness (Poc) and Interpersonal behaviour correctness (IBc) , and (ii). language-quality -Perplexity (PPL), BERTScore-F1 (BSF1), Response-length (R_LEN ).

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we ask the same six experts to evaluate the e-THERAPIST.
answer_4.guideline: Each evaluator engaged with the system multiple times, and interactions were cross-verified by psychotherapists. Evaluations were conducted on an integer Likert scale of 1-5.
